notes: This sheet is NOT Mt Adams/Eden Park: it is the east riverfront at the foot of Mt Adams (E. 3rd, E. Front, Collard, Whittaker; Ohio River on the east, P.C.C.&St.L. R.R. sidings between E. Front and the river; north edge 'SEE VOLUME SEVEN'). Two panels. 'main': everything right of the thick border at x ~1760 plus the whole top of the page above y ~2470 (Bains Pl. at the top down to Whittaker Alley at y ~3900, '200' printed below it). 'inset': the lower-left panel (x ~230-1760, y ~2480-4600), which is the continuation of the main panel south of Whittaker Alley (the block between Whittaker Alley and the panel top at y ~2590 repeats the main panel's strip y ~3930-4100), running down to Whittaker Street with sheet 110 below. Whittaker Alley and its crossings therefore appear in both panels (recorded in each with its part). The inset is drawn ~1500 px west and ~1040 px north of the main panel and very slightly rotated. Names: 'BAINS PL. (WASHINGTON)' (40', wood steps along its middle), 'HIGH ST.' and 'GLADSTONE AV.' entering Bains from Volume 7 to the north (T), 'E. 3RD', 'E. FRONT', 'COLLARD', 'ASH' (60'), 'WHITTAKER ALLEY' (16'/15'), 'WHITTAKER' (50'). Bare names given 'Street'. Ash runs off the west edge ENE and meets Collard at an angle point where the name changes (no other street there); recorded as an Ash/Collard junction. Collard west of East 3rd (~60 ft, no width printed) and Collard east of East 3rd (33') meet East 3rd at two T-junctions ~270 px apart (a jog), both recorded. Collard ends at East Front. East 3rd: ~60 ft north of Collard ('60'' printed at ~(1830,2060)), 50 ft at the top and in the south ('50'' printed). East 3rd and East Front diverge at the top around a filling-station triangle (apex ~(2640,520)); north of it a single wide roadway runs off the top edge into Volume 7; the two centrelines (and their water pipes) do not meet on the sheet, so no East 3rd/East Front point is recorded. East Front's east side is the railroad: only its west line is drawn, so its centre is taken 55 ft (95 px) east of that line, which agrees with its 10" water pipe (main panel) and with a 40 ft width in the inset ('40'' printed there). Bains Place ends at East 3rd (T). The 15 ft alley (unnamed) runs from Collard south through Whittaker Alley to Whittaker Street (crossing recorded in both panels). The 17 ft gap between the blocks south of Whittaker in the inset (x ~755-814) is an unnamed alley entering from sheet 110; recorded as a T. East 3rd and East Front continue south of Whittaker Street onto sheet 110; Whittaker continues west of East 3rd (cross) and ends at East Front (railroad beyond). Lines through block 1 (between Ash/Collard and Bains Place) are lot lines, not streets.
